d: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.
Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.
The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.
A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.
If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.
Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.
